content.text: April 4, 2026Updated April 5, 2026, 3:15 a.m. CTThe NHL playoff picture features multiple wild-card spots with multi-team ties going into play on April 4.In the West, the Nashville Predators are tied with the San Jose Sharks and Los Angeles Kings at 79 points for the second wild-card spot. San Jose enters the day with the advantage via a game in hand. The Sharks host the Predators tonight.A four-team tie for the second wild-card spot in the East at 88 points includes Ottawa, Detroit, Columbus and Philadelphia. The latter two teams also have an eye on the third spot in the Metro, with the Islanders at 89 points and with one more game played.Here's the full NHL playoff picture heading into tonight: NHL playoff pictureAs of 1 a.m. on April 5Western Conference standingsCentral Division top 31.
